title: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Support Engineer.
description:
We are looking for an experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Support Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AEM Administration, Production Support, Apache Web Server, Dispatcher, and Azure Cloud Infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have experience managing and supporting both AEM On-Premises and AEM as a Cloud Service environments, troubleshooting production issues, maintaining infrastructure stability, and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA). 
 Key Responsibilities :- Administer and provide production support for Adobe Experience Manager On-Premises and AEM as a Cloud Service environments . Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary 
 You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDoxs SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 In this role you will: Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10 or more years building production software. 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. 
 Preferred Qualifications EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 
 Compensation Base salary of 80 to 120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. Stock options. Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. Company cab service for all Noida employees.

Job Information Item Details Job Title QA/QC Engineer Department Engineering / QA-QC Location Chennai, India Reports To Engineering Manager / Engineering & BIM Manager Direct Reports N/A 2. Job Purpose The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all engineering deliverables issued from the Chennai offshore office for UAE and GCC projects are reviewed, checked, and verified against applicable project requirements, contract documents, standards, codes, client and consultant instructions, and company procedures prior to issue. The role acts as a quality assurance and control gate for engineering outputs, with primary responsibility for reconfirming that drawing titles, drawing numbers, project references, revision/status details, codes, administrative requirements, coordination information, and document control standards are fully complied with before submission. The QA/QC Engineer supports the Engineering & BIM Manager, Engineering Manager, and Lead Engineers by ensuring that engineering deliverables are complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant, thereby reducing errors, rework, delays, and rejection risk on UAE and GCC projects. This role is focused on offshore engineering quality control and document compliance, not site inspection or construction QA/QC activities. 3. Key Responsibilities 3.1 Engineering Deliverable Review and Compliance Control Review all engineering deliverables prior to issue, including drawings, submittals, registers, schedules, technical documents, and correspondence. Verify that deliverables comply with contract requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, codes, consultant requirements, and company procedures. Ensure all administrative and technical requirements are correctly reflected before issue. Check that drawing titles, drawing numbers, project references, revision status, discipline references, and issue status are accurate and consistent. Confirm that deliverables are properly categorized, traceable, and issued under the correct project document control system. 3.2 Drawing and Document Quality Assurance Check engineering drawings and related documents for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance with project standards. Verify document formatting, title blocks, revision history, numbering sequence, and approval status. Ensure references, notes, legends, symbols, specifications, and cross-disciplinary coordination information are correctly applied. Confirm that all required attachments, supporting documents, and transmittals are included before issue. Identify omissions, inconsistencies, errors, and non-conformances and ensure they are corrected prior to submission. 3.3 Standards, Codes, and Administrative Verification Reconfirm compliance with applicable local and international codes, project standards, authority requirements, and consultant instructions. Ensure administrative requirements, approval pathways, and document issue procedures are followed. Verify that drawing and submittal packages reflect the latest approved project information. Ensure revision control, issue status, and document classifications are maintained in accordance with project and company systems. Support the maintenance of compliance registers and document control logs as required. 3.4 Coordination with Engineering Teams Coordinate with the Engineering Manager, Lead Engineers, BIM teams, and technical staff to resolve comments and close gaps before issue. Highlight discrepancies, missing information, or conflicts in engineering deliverables to the relevant discipline lead. Support timely correction and re-issue of documents where required. Promote quality awareness across the engineering team and reinforce the importance of first-time-right submissions. 3.5 Offshore Project Support Support the offshore Chennai office in the production and issue of engineering deliverables for UAE and GCC projects. Ensure outputs are suitable for submission to consultants, clients, authorities, and project stakeholders. Assist in maintaining discipline and consistency across multiple concurrent projects. Support timely issue of quality-controlled deliverables to meet project deadlines and avoid delay at site or in approvals. 3.6 QA/QC Audits, Logs, and Reporting Conduct routine QA/QC checks on engineering deliverables and maintain records of findings. Record comments, non-conformances, corrections, and close-out actions. Maintain QA/QC checklists, compliance logs, and issue records for audit and traceability. Provide feedback on recurring issues, trends, and improvement opportunities. Report quality status, document issues, and unresolved concerns to the Engineering Manager or Engineering & BIM Manager. 3.7 Continuous Improvement and Process Discipline Support continuous improvement of engineering review processes, checklists, templates, and document control practices. Recommend enhancements to reduce rework, improve accuracy, and strengthen submission quality. Promote discipline in quality assurance, coding, numbering, and administrative control across engineering deliverables. Support internal awareness of company standards, procedures, and best practices. 4. Qualifications and Experience Degree in Engineering, Construction, or related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in QA/QC, document control, or engineering deliverable checking within MEP or construction environments. Experience in offshore engineering support for UAE or GCC projects is preferred. Knowledge of engineering documentation, drawing control, and compliance processes is essential. 5. Essential Skills and Competencies Strong attention to detail Knowledge of engineering document control and QA/QC processes Ability to verify standards, codes, numbering, titles, and project references Understanding of MEP engineering deliverables and submission workflows Good communication and coordination skills Proficiency in MS Office applications Ability to identify non-conformances and follow up closure Ability to work in a structured offshore environment with multiple project demands 6. Desirable Skills and Competencies Familiarity with UAE/GCC project documentation requirements Experience with engineering review workflows in offshore offices Familiarity with BIM/CDE document environments Experience with QA/QC checklists and engineering transmittal systems Exposure to MEP shop drawing and submittal processes 7. Other Requirements Conduct self and business in line with company Purpose, Vision, Values, Policies, Procedures, and Code of Conduct. Maintain confidentiality, accuracy, and professionalism in all document review activities. Comply with company standards and project-specific document control requirements. Undertake any other reasonable duties as required by management to support business needs.

title: Head of Engineering - EHR Integration
description:
Head of Engineering: EHR Integration 
 Pay: 80 to 120 lakh per year
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
 Type: Full-time
 Hours: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
 Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)
 Department: EHR Integration
 On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday
 Reports to: Chief Technology Officer 
 About XpertDox 
 XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary 
 You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDoxs SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 In this role you will: Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10 or more years building production software. 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. 
 Preferred Qualifications EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 
 Compensation Base salary of 80 to 120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. Stock options. Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. Company cab service for all Noida employees. 
 To Apply Apply at https://careers.xpertdox.com/ . 
 XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) - Bangalore / Pune
description:
Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The Production Support Engineer diagnoses, troubleshoots, and resolves complex production and customer issues across modern banking platform environments. This is a level 2 role: the engineer takes tickets directly from Tier-1 banks, with no first-line team in front, reproduces issues and hands them to the owning engineering team with clear evidence, and keeps the customer informed throughout. The role is hands-on and customer-facing, requiring strong investigation skills, clear communication, and the ability to connect application behavior, Kubernetes infrastructure, logs, metrics, and customer impact. The role offers an advancement path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and platform layers. Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to identify root causes and correlate symptoms across systems. Troubleshoot Kubernetes and container issues, including pods, services, deployments, networking, and resources. Reproduce issues and hand them over to the owning engineering team with logs, traces, timestamps, and steps to reproduce. Customer-Facing Support Engage directly with enterprise banking customers to understand, investigate, and resolve technical issues, including issues caused by changes on the customer's side, such as firewall or network changes, without assigning blame. Acknowledge new issues quickly and give customers regular updates while an investigation is open, even when there is no news. Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders. Observability & AI-Assisted Operations Use tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or similar to investigate behavior. Work with the platform's AI-driven SRE capabilities incident insights, auto-remediation, and AI-based root cause analysis validating findings and acting on them. Improve runbooks, dashboards, alerts, and support processes based on recurring issues and lessons learned. Platform Support Support Kubernetes-based banking platform environments across multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), hybrid, and customer-hosted deployments. Assist with deployment-related troubleshooting when required; deployment ownership is a plus, not a core requirement. In quieter periods, contribute to projects alongside the platform engineering team. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES Technical Expertise 7 to 12 years of Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across production or customer-facing technical environments the single most important capability for this role. Working knowledge of Kubernetes: what pods and services are, how traffic reaches the cluster and moves between pods, and how storage works; hands-on troubleshooting with kubectl. Building or running clusters is not required. Solid Linux troubleshooting, including processes, memory, disk space, and inodes. The platform does not run on Windows. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior. Networking is one of the most common causes of issues on the platform. Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or another relational database, such as replication, primary/replica, and active-passive setups. Deep database administration is not required. Ability to read, interpret, and correlate logs, metrics, traces, and alerts; comfortable using Grafana dashboards, running metric queries, and following traces. The engineer uses these tools and does not need to have built them. Customer-Facing Experience (Mandatory) At least one proven customer-facing technical role is required. Experience working directly with customers during investigations, escalations, or production support scenarios. Operating Style Strong ownership mindset and bias toward resolution. Practical, hands-on problem solver who enjoys investigation and troubleshooting. Works as a peer within a small team. AI-native: integrates LLMs and AI tooling into daily investigation and support work. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, banking platforms, fintech systems, or regulated infrastructure. Familiarity with cloud or hybrid environments such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-prem enterprise deployments. Exposure to deployment workflows, Helm, Terraform, Flux, ArgoCD, Kafka, or distributed databases. Awareness of Kubernetes networking plugins (CNI), for example Cilium. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, working directly with customers, and bringing structure and clarity to complex technical situations. They are hands-on, calm under pressure, and comfortable moving between logs, metrics, customer context, and engineering discussions to get to root cause. This is not an SRE, DevOps, architecture, or platform engineering role, and the engineer does not build or own the infrastructure — engineers looking to architect and build systems will find a better fit in our Platform Engineer openings. For those who want to grow into platform engineering, this role offers a path there, typically over one to two years. IMPACT & SCOPE Direct impact on customer trust, production reliability, and operational continuity for Tier-1 banking institutions. High visibility across customer, support, engineering, platform, and product teams. WHY JOIN This role offers the opportunity to support a next-generation banking platform used by some of the world's largest financial institutions. It combines the technical complexity of Kubernetes-based infrastructure, the urgency of production support, and the customer impact of enterprise banking. Work alongside the platform engineering team on projects, not only on tickets. Gain hands-on exposure to multi-cloud Kubernetes and an AI-driven SRE agent that diagnoses and remediates incidents. A clear path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction.

Key Skills: Production engineering,Customer support,Production support,Kubernetes,Production,Grafana,L2

Business Development Manager (BDM) Mandatory Requirements: Candidates must have their own personal laptop and a two-wheeler/four-wheeler for work-related requirements. Applications without both will not be considered. Company: FlairUP
 Location: Vivek Khand 2, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
 Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO)
 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 Shift Timings: 12:00 PM 09:00 PM (IST) 
 FlairUP is looking for a proactive, confident, and target-driven Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive business growth through lead generation, client acquisition, relationship management, and successful deal closures. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in business development, sales, client handling, negotiations, and managing the complete sales cycle. The candidate should be capable of identifying new business opportunities, building a strong client network, and consistently achieving revenue targets. Key Responsibilities Lead Generation: Identify and generate qualified business leads through networking, market research, references, online platforms, and other relevant channels. Client Acquisition: Identify potential clients, understand their business requirements, present suitable solutions, and convert prospects into long-term clients. Meetings & Deal Closures: Conduct client meetings, deliver business presentations, negotiate commercial terms, and independently close deals. Sales Pipeline Management: Manage the complete sales pipeline, maintain lead databases, track prospects, and ensure consistent follow-ups. Business Development: Explore new markets, identify growth opportunities, and develop strategies to expand the company's client base. Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to encourage repeat business and referrals. Proposal & Contract Management: Prepare and review business proposals, quotations, pitch presentations, client agreements, and contracts. Market Research: Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments to identify potential business opportunities. Sales Reporting: Maintain regular sales reports, track conversion rates, monitor performance, and provide timely updates to management. Revenue Achievement: Work towards monthly and quarterly sales targets and contribute to the company's overall business growth. Internal Coordination: Collaborate with the marketing and other internal teams to improve lead generation, client communication, and business development activities. Required Skills & Qualifications Proven experience in Business Development, Sales, or Client Acquisition. Strong experience in lead generation, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closures. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong presentation, networking, and relationship management abilities. Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle. Good understanding of sales pipelines, business proposals, and commercial negotiations. Target-oriented mindset with the ability to achieve revenue goals. Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of business development activities. Preferred Experience Experience working with IT services companies, digital marketing agencies, or other B2B service-based organizations will be preferred. Candidates with an established professional network and experience in acquiring business clients will have an added advantage. Candidates should be comfortable with client meetings and business development activities. Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@flairup.in.

The role involves regular field visits, project tracking, technical sales of modular support systems, pipe hangers, channels, and MEP solutions, while working closely with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders to achieve sales targets.

 Business Development & Project Sales Identify and develop new business opportunities, customers, and projects within the assigned territory. Conduct regular field visits to construction sites, industrial projects, consultants, EPC contractors, and end users. Generate enquiries through market intelligence, networking, cold calling, and customer outreach activities. title: Real Estate Sales Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager to lead and drive sales activities for our residential real estate projects. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in real estate sales, team management, customer relationship management, lead conversion, and achieving revenue targets. The candidate will be responsible for developing sales strategies, managing the sales team, driving site visits, converting prospective customers into bookings, and ensuring achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets. Key Responsibilities 1. Sales Strategy & Target Achievement Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Drive residential property sales, including apartments, villas, and plotted developments. Monitor sales performance and take corrective actions to improve conversions. Identify new business opportunities and explore potential customer segments. 2. Team Management & Leadership Lead, manage, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and team targets. Set sales targets and monitor team performance through regular reviews. Conduct regular training sessions to improve product knowledge, negotiation, and closing skills. Ensure proper allocation and follow-up of leads among team members. 3. Lead Management & Conversion Manage leads generated through digital marketing, channel partners, referrals, and direct enquiries. Ensure timely follow-up of prospective customers and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. Drive customer meetings, property presentations, and site visits. Improve lead-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion ratios. 4. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable residential properties. Handle customer queries, objections, negotiations, and escalations. Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales cycle. 5. Channel Partner Management Develop and maintain relationships with real estate channel partners and brokers. Identify and onboard new channel partners to expand the sales network. Drive channel partner engagement and monitor their sales performance. Coordinate with channel partners to generate quality leads and achieve booking targets. 6. Reporting & Coordination Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports. Monitor lead status, site visits, negotiations, bookings, and closures. Coordinate with Marketing, CRM, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure smooth sales execution. Ensure accurate updating of leads, customer interactions, and sales activities in CRM. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of the Bengaluru real estate market. Proven experience in residential real estate sales. Excellent leadership and team management skills. Strong negotiation, communication, and closing abilities. Customer relationship and stakeholder management. Ability to work under pressure and achieve ambitious sales targets. Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Excel, and sales reporting. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets. Number of bookings and revenue generated. Lead-to-site-visit conversion ratio. Site-visit-to-booking conversion ratio. Sales team productivity and target achievement. Channel partner contribution to overall sales. Lead follow-up efficiency and pipeline management. Customer satisfaction and booking cancellation ratio. Experience Requirements 510 years of overall experience in sales. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in residential real estate sales. Experience in managing and leading a sales team. Prior experience handling premium residential projects will be an added advantage.

title: Manager- Compliance and Government Sales
description:
Job description We are building an ecosystem. We need people who can open doors in Government and win the bids behind them. 
 About Sambhav Sambhav is Indias first Discrete Ecosystem Orchestrator, bringing together 29 specialised scopes across 9 verticals to deliver integrated solutions to enterprises and Government institutions. We work across logistics technology, enterprise and defence technology, and EdTech and workforce skilling. Sambhav operates online under the brand Hum Dekh Lenge (www.humdekhlenge.com). 
 The role You will build Sambhavs Government business end to end: finding the right tenders and departments, checking that we qualify, putting together compliant bids with our partner organisations, and following each one through to award. One successful bid can open doors across several verticals. It suits someone who is as comfortable in a pre-bid meeting as with an eligibility checklist and a submission deadline. 
 Key responsibilities Government business development Identify and map target ministries, departments, PSUs and state agencies relevant to Sambhavs verticals Build relationships with officials, procurement teams and nodal officers, and track upcoming projects before tenders are published Attend pre-bid meetings, department visits and industry forums across Delhi NCR Work with partner organisations to form the right combination of scopes for each opportunity Tender management Track tenders, RFPs and EOIs daily on GeM, CPPP and state e-procurement portals, and shortlist those worth pursuing Study tender documents and corrigenda, and check eligibility and pre-qualification criteria before a bid decision Maintain a tender tracker with deadlines, status, EMD and bid security details, and outcomes Manage vendor registrations and empanelments on Government portals and keep them current Bid management Prepare complete technical and financial bids, including compliance statements, BOQs, declarations and supporting credentials Coordinate inputs, authorisations and documents from internal teams and partner organisations against the submission timeline Raise pre-bid queries, submit bids on the portals, and handle post-bid clarifications Follow up through evaluation to award, and coordinate work orders, agreements and performance security after a win Keep the Firms statutory and commercial documents (registrations, certificates, financials, experience records) bid-ready at all times 
 Who should apply 0–3 years of experience in tender or bid management, Government sales or business development; freshers with strong drive are welcome Working familiarity with GeM and e-procurement portals is a strong plus, as is willingness to learn Government procurement rules quickly Strong attention to detail and the discipline to meet submission deadlines without follow-up Comfort meeting Government officials and following up persistently Clear written and spoken communication in English and Hindi, including formal letter and document drafting Good command of MS Office or Google Workspace for bid documents and trackers An ownership mindset and willingness to travel across Delhi NCR 
 We actively encourage women to apply. 
 Why join Be part of the founding team and the company’s 0-to-1 growth Bid with an entire ecosystem behind you, not a single product Interact directly with central and state government officials and founders of 20+ partner companies Own bids end to end in a lean, Make-in-India team

title: Digital Marketing Specialist - B2B Technology Services
description:
Role Overview: We are looking for a hands-on B2B marketer who combines excellent communication, strong campaign execution, and practical experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub and Content Hub .
 You will translate marketing strategy into consistent execution across content, social media, email, and web campaigns to strengthen Astrecas brand and generate qualified sales conversations.
 You will work closely with our fractional CMO for strategic direction and collaborate with sales, leadership, and technical subject matter experts. Our HubSpot technical team will support custom development, integrations, and advanced configurations. You will own day-to-day marketing execution and independently manage routine HubSpot activities.
 
 Role & responsibilities: 1. Own the marketing execution calendar, coordinate inputs, manage 
 deadlines, and proactively communicate progress and blockers.
2. Create clear, engaging B2B content, including LinkedIn posts, blogs, 
 case studies, email campaigns, landing pages, and sales collateral.
 3. Interview technical subject matter experts and translate their 
 expertise into accurate messaging focused on customer challenges 
 and business outcomes.
 4. Build, launch, and optimize campaigns in HubSpot Marketing Hub, 
 including audience segmentation, forms, emails, and lead nurturing 
 workflows.
 5. Create, publish, and update website pages, landing pages, and blogs 
 in HubSpot Content Hub using established templates.
 6. Manage Astrecas social media presence, with a strong focus on 
 LinkedIn, and maintain a consistent publishing and engagement 
 schedule.
 7. Coordinate paid campaigns under the fractional CMOs direction, 
 including creative development, setup, tracking, and optimization.
 8. Apply SEO and conversion optimization practices to improve content 
 visibility, website engagement, and lead generation.
 9. Translate marketing needs into clear requirements for the HubSpot 
 technical team, coordinate delivery, and validate completed work.
 10. Collaborate with sales on lead handoff, campaign follow-up, and 
 feedback on lead quality.
 11. Monitor campaign and website performance, explain findings clearly, 
 and recommend improvements tied to qualified leads and sales 
 opportunities. 

 Required Qualifications: 1. Communication and Ownership: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to write compelling content, present campaign plans, and explain results clearly. Ability to ask thoughtful questions. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver work without daily prompting. Confidence collaborating directly with US-based leadership, sales colleagues, and technical teams. 
 2. HubSpot and Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience with both HubSpot Marketing Hub and Content Hub , beyond campaign planning and coordination.
 Ability to independently build and troubleshoot routine emails, forms, landing pages, audience segments, and lead nurturing workflows. Experience publishing and updating website and blog content using established templates, including basic formatting and SEO settings.
Working knowledge of campaign tracking, website analytics, and conversion measurement. Ability to investigate common setup or execution issues, describe problems clearly, and collaborate with the HubSpot technical team on more complex requirements. 
 3. Marketing Experience : Demonstrated experience executing B2B digital marketing campaigns, preferably in technology, consulting, SaaS, or professional services.
 Strong content writing skills. Experience managing LinkedIn content and engagement. Working knowledge of SEO, email marketing, content strategy, and conversion optimization. Ability to interpret campaign data and connect marketing activity to qualified leads, sales conversations, and pipeline contribution. 
 Preferred candidate profile: 1. Experience marketing Salesforce, HubSpot, CRM, automation, or 
 related technology services. 2. Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, or other 
 paid acquisition platforms.
3. Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
4. Experience collaborating with developers on website improvements, 
 tracking, integrations, and marketing automation.
5. Relevant HubSpot certifications supported by practical experience.

title: Accounts & Finance Manager
description:
The Accounts & Finance Manager owns the company's full accounting and finance cycle, from day-to-day bookkeeping through to month-end close, year-end reporting and forecasting. The role ensures accurate, timely financial information, keeps the company compliant with statutory and tax requirements, and gives management clear insight to support business decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities Full-Spectrum Accounting & General Ledger Oversee the full set of accounts, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting and fixed assets. Maintain the general ledger and chart of accounts, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately and on time. Review and approve journal entries, accruals, prepayments and provisions. Perform monthly bank, intercompany and balance sheet reconciliations. Month-End & Year-End Closing Lead the month-end closing process within agreed timelines. Prepare monthly management accounts, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement. Manage the year-end closing and prepare full-year financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards. Prepare schedules and coordinate with external auditors through to audit sign-off. Financial Reporting & Analysis Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports for management and the board. Analyse P&L performance, margins and cost drivers, and explain variances against budget and prior periods. Track key financial KPIs and highlight risks and opportunities to management. Budgeting & Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting process together with department heads. Prepare rolling forecasts for revenue, expenses and cash flow. Build and maintain financial models to support pricing, investment and business decisions. Cash Flow & Treasury Monitor daily cash position and manage cash flow forecasting. Manage banking relationships, credit facilities and payment schedules. Oversee credit control and debt collection to keep receivables healthy. Tax & Statutory Compliance Ensure timely compliance with corporate tax, GST requirement. Liaise with tax agents, company secretary and relevant authorities. Keep up to date with changes in accounting standards and tax regulations. 
 Requirements Qualifications Chartered Accountancy (CA) or CMA is a must. Degree in Accounting or Finance, and/or a professional qualification such as ACCA Experience At least 5 to 7 years of full-spectrum accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role. Proven track record handling month-end and year-end closing, statutory audits and tax matters. Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of accounting standards and local tax regulations. Proficient in accounting software / ERP such as Microsoft dynamics Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, financial modelling). Familiarity with BI or reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) is a plus.

title: Store Manager
description:
Job Description - Store Manager 
 Company: Innovative Lighting Designs Limited (ILDL)
 Location: Okhla Phase 1, New Delhi
 Department: Stores & Logistics 
 Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent, on-site

 Job Summary 
ILDL is seeking an experienced Store Manager to run its store operations end to end. The incumbent will make sure that products reach project sites accurately, on time, undamaged and that stock, order, dispatch and sample records are accurate and current at all times. The role involves leading the store team and working daily with the Accounts, Technical, CRM, Procurement and Assembly teams. 
 Role & Responsibilities 
 Store operations and inventory 
 Manage end-to-end store operations, including material receipt, verification against purchase orders, storage, issue of material and order processing. Maintain accurate stock and order records, with inward and outward entries posted on the same working day and order status updated daily. Plan and conduct regular physical stock verification, investigate variances and close them within the agreed time. Ensure Material Receipt Notes (MRN) and daily material receipt and outward (DMR / DMO) records are prepared accurately, with shortages and damages recorded at the time of receipt. 
 Dispatch and logistics 
 Plan and coordinate packing, dispatch and delivery of confirmed orders, including transport mode and freight arrangements. Maintain the dispatch tracker and keep it matched with actual dispatches; issue delivery challans for temporary dispatches and samples. Ensure correct packing as per order specifications and maintain packaging standards to minimise damage, shortages and wrong shipments. Keep the CRM team updated on dispatch status, with the required documents, on the day of dispatch. 
 Samples and mock-ups 
 Supervise availability, tracking and dispatch of samples and mock-up material, including decorative and automation samples, so that Technical and CRM teams receive them on time. 
 Procurement support 
 Prepare import and local indents as required and coordinate with the Procurement team on timelines. 
 Coordination and queries 
 Coordinate daily with the Accounts, Technical, CRM, Procurement and Assembly teams. Respond to and resolve stock-related, ongoing-project and completed-project queries within the agreed turnaround. 
 Team and safety 
 Lead, train and supervise the store team, including store assistants, helpers and local delivery staff; allocate duties and review performance against defined KRAs. Ensure safe handling, storage, housekeeping and safety practices in the store and during loading and unloading. Prepare weekly and monthly reports on stock accuracy, on-time dispatch, damage and shortages, pending orders and open queries. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 Minimum 7 years of experience in store, warehouse, inventory or logistics management, including experience of leading a team. Experience in lighting, electrical, electronics, building materials or other project-based products is preferred; experience of handling import consignments and fragile or high-value items is an advantage. Hands-on knowledge of inventory control, stock verification, material receipt and issue, and dispatch documentation such as delivery challans, invoices and e-way bills. Working knowledge of ERP or inventory software and MS Excel for records and reports. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and on-time delivery. Good written and verbal communication, and the ability to coordinate with several departments. Ability to supervise, train and motivate a team of store staff. Willingness to work on-site at the store. 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management or Commerce is preferred.

Key Skills: Store Operation,Store operations,Store keeping,Store supervision,Management,Store management,Inventory,Planning

title: Business Head | Pricious Metals & Base Metal
description:
Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .
 Key Requirements: 
 B.E. / B.Tech. in Engineering ; M.Tech. or MBA preferred.

title: General Manager Finance & Accounts (Taxation, Audit & Compliance)
description:
Role Objective: Key objective of this role is to lead the group's accounting, taxation, audit and compliance function across all Indian and overseas entities of Biotech Healthcare Group, ensuring robust financial processes and strong internal controls. 
 The role is responsible for delivering a clean, reconciled trial balance every month across all subsidiaries; preparing quarterly consolidated financial statements; owning the annual statutory audit with Big 4 auditors; building a robust internal audit and internal financial controls (IFC) framework, including plant and operational process audits; and ensuring full global regulatory and tax compliance. 
 The position will lead a team of ~20 across accounts, taxation and internal audit, and will serve as the company's key interface with statutory and internal auditors, tax consultants and government revenue departments (Income Tax, GST, FEMA and Customs), ensuring a clean compliance track record for the group. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Education Minimum: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA). Desirable: Additional certification in IFRS (e.g. DipIFR) or Internal Audit / Controls (e.g. CIA, CISA). Experience Requirement Minimum: 1215 years of post-qualification experience in accounts, taxation, audit and compliance. Experience of handling Big 4 statutory audits from the company side audit readiness, schedules, queries and timely sign-off. Experience of managing financial processes across subsidiaries timely accounting, monthly closure with clean trial balance and preparation of quarterly consolidated financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow). Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP experience. Desirable: Big 4 background trained at a Big 4 firm. Experience in a multi-entity manufacturing group, preferably in pharma / healthcare / medical devices. Exposure to overseas group entities and global / group-level compliance. 
 Role Requirements Strong experience in group accounting, monthly close and consolidation across multiple entities. Deep working knowledge of Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs, along with IFC requirements. Hands-on experience in internal audit, internal financial controls and plant / operational process audits in a manufacturing environment to identify leakages and gaps. Proven experience of dealing with government revenue departments – tax assessments, scrutiny notices, appeals, hearings and refunds. Track record of automating controls and processes in SAP. Strong team leadership, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work with auditors, consultants, authorities and senior management. 
 Role & Responsibilities 1. Deliver a clean, reconciled trial balance for every group entity and subsidiary each month. 2. Prepare quarterly consolidated financial statements for the group (P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow) in line with Ind AS / IFRS. 3. Lead financial processes across the group – timely accounting, process controls, a standardised close calendar, reconciliations and intercompany accounting. 4. Own the group's annual statutory audit with Big 4 auditors end to end – audit readiness, schedules, queries and timely sign-off. 5. Build a robust internal audit programme with the in-house Internal Audit team and externally appointed auditors; strengthen internal financial controls (IFC) and close audit findings on time. 6. Roll out uniform internal audit standards and checks across all group entities. 7. Automate all major controls across the group in SAP to ensure there are no leakages. 8. Conduct plant and operational process audits across manufacturing facilities to identify leakages, gaps and inefficiencies, and drive corrective actions to closure. 9. Ensure full compliance with Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs across the group. 10. Manage tax audits and assessments, both direct and indirect. 11. Oversee compliance of overseas group entities in coordination with local advisors. 12. Represent the company before Income Tax, GST, FEMA and Customs authorities for assessments, scrutiny notices, appeals, hearings and refunds; coordinate with tax consultants and counsel, and maintain a clean track record with the departments. 13. Lead, develop and review the accounts, taxation and internal audit team, building capability and succession cover for key positions. 14. Report key compliance, audit and financial-close status to the Financial Controller and senior management on a regular basis. 
 Functional Skills Required In-depth knowledge of group accounting, monthly close, intercompany accounting and consolidation. Expertise in statutory audit management with Big 4 auditors. Strong understanding of Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs requirements. Expertise in internal audit, IFC design and testing, and plant / operational process audits. Experience in handling tax assessments, notices, appeals and refunds with revenue departments. Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and automation of controls and processes. 
 Behavioral Skills Required Strong team leadership, with the ability to lead and develop a team of 20+ including Chartered Accountants. Good communication and presentation skills. High integrity, ownership and accountability for timelines and compliance. Analytical thinking with attention to detail. Effective stakeholder management with auditors, consultants, authorities and internal teams. Determination and keen interest in the role. 
 Team Size to be Handled: ~20 team members, including 3–4 Chartered Accountants, across accounts, taxation and internal audit. Reporting to the Financial Controller. 
 Important Links: Website: https://biotechhealthcare.com/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/biotechhealthcare/ Instagram: Biotech Vision Care 
 Biotech is an Equal Opportunity Organization promoting diversity while ensuring no discrimination on any ground, including gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, etc.

This role focuses on portfolio-level reporting, asset performance analysis, forecasting, valuation support, and investor reporting execution. This role is deeply operational and finance-focused, involving financial modeling, asset performance tracking, investor reporting, and property-level analytics. You will work closely with U.S.-based asset managers and property management teams to drive data-backed decision making and ensure portfolio performance is optimized.

Perform hold/sell, refinancing, and capital expenditure ROI analysis. Validate underwriting assumptions against actual asset performance.
 Performance Tracking & Reporting Analyse monthly property financials, rent rolls, and operating statements. Track KPIs including occupancy, NOI, collections, and leasing performance. Prepare variance analysis and portfolio performance reports. Maintain asset performance dashboards.
 Property Management Support Monitor leasing activity, delinquency trends, and operational KPIs. Audit rent rolls and ensure data accuracy. Track action items from property management meetings.

 Leasing & Revenue Analytics Analyse leasing trends, rent growth, concessions, and lease trade-outs. Perform market and competitor analysis using industry tools. Support pricing and revenue optimization initiatives.
 Capital Expenditure & Budget Tracking Monitor CapEx budgets and project spending. Track renovation progress and investment returns. Reconcile invoices and identify discrepancies.

 Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in U.S. real estate acquisitions, investment analysis, or CRE advisory   Strong financial modelling and analytical skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Experience with Google Workspace. Experience in asset management, commercial real estate, investment analysis, or financial analysis is preferred. Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow analysis, budgeting, and forecasting. Excellent communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Opportunity to work alongside top finance, investment, and real estate professionals. Long-term career progression within a fast-growing global organization.

title: Head Finance | Automotive Components | Vadodara | CA
description:
Location: Vadodara 
 Our client is a global automotive components manufacturing group with a strong international presence , expanding its operations in India with the establishment of a new manufacturing plant in Gujarat ( Vadodara ) 
 We are looking for an experienced Head Finance to lead the finance function for India and play a critical role in establishing robust financial systems, controls and processes for the new manufacturing operation. The ideal candidate will have 1520 years of experience , preferably with a strong background in automotive components / auto parts manufacturing , and should have hands-on expertise in plant finance, manufacturing finance, costing, working capital, capex, commercial finance, taxation and financial controls . 
 The position will be based in Vadodara , with regular travel to the Gujarat manufacturing plant. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Finance Leadership & Business Partnering Lead the overall finance function for the India business and partner with the India leadership team and global finance organization. Develop and implement financial processes, controls, policies and reporting systems for the India operation. Provide strategic financial insights to the management on profitability, cost optimization, investments and business performance. Act as a strong business partner to the Plant, Operations, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain teams. 
 2. Plant Finance & Manufacturing Finance Lead end-to-end finance operations for the Gujarat manufacturing plant. Establish and manage plant finance, cost accounting and manufacturing reporting systems . Monitor production costs, conversion costs, material consumption, labour costs, overheads and manufacturing variances. Drive standard costing, product costing, BOM costing and variance analysis . Analyse production efficiency, yield, scrap, wastage, productivity and cost per unit. Work closely with plant leadership to identify and deliver cost reduction and operational efficiency initiatives . Establish robust financial controls across stores, inventory, production, procurement and dispatch. 
 3. Budgeting, Planning & MIS Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process for India. Prepare rolling forecasts and long-term financial plans. Develop comprehensive monthly MIS and management dashboards covering revenue, margins, costs, working capital, cash flow and profitability. Analyse actual versus budget performance and drive corrective actions. Provide financial analysis for new products, customers, capacity expansion and business opportunities. 
 4. Capex & New Plant Financial Management Lead financial planning and control for plant setup, machinery acquisition and expansion projects . Evaluate CAPEX proposals and prepare financial/business cases for investments. Monitor project budgets, expenditure, capitalization and project ROI. Work with the plant and project teams to ensure effective utilization of capital. Establish appropriate controls for fixed assets, capitalization and depreciation. 
 5. Working Capital & Cash Flow Drive effective working capital management across the business. Monitor receivables, inventory, payables and cash conversion cycle . Improve cash flow forecasting and liquidity management. Develop initiatives to optimize inventory and reduce working capital requirements. Work closely with customers and commercial teams on collections and credit management. 
 6. Commercial & Customer Finance Partner with the commercial and sales teams on customer profitability and pricing. Evaluate commercial proposals, RFQs, new business opportunities and customer contracts from a financial perspective. Analyse customer-wise profitability, contribution margins and cost movements. Support annual price negotiations and cost-reduction / localization discussions with automotive OEMs and Tier-1 customers . Monitor customer claims, debit notes, rebates and commercial settlements. 
 7. Financial Accounting, Controls & Compliance Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual financial closure. Oversee statutory accounting, taxation, audits and regulatory compliance. Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Companies Act, Income Tax, transfer pricing and other applicable regulations . Establish strong internal controls and ensure adherence to global finance policies. Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax advisors, banks and other financial institutions. 
 8. Inventory & Cost Control Drive robust inventory accounting and controls across raw materials, WIP, finished goods and stores. Monitor inventory ageing, slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Lead periodic physical verification and reconciliation. Ensure accurate product costing and inventory valuation. Work with operations and procurement teams to reduce material and inventory costs. 
 9. Treasury & Banking Manage banking relationships and day-to-day treasury requirements. Oversee cash management, fund requirements, working capital facilities and foreign exchange exposures. Support financing requirements related to plant expansion and CAPEX. Ensure effective management of foreign currency transactions in coordination with the global finance team. 
 10. Team Leadership & Global Finance Interface Build and lead a high-performing finance team in India. Establish clear roles, processes and accountability across plant and corporate finance. Work closely with the Global CFO / Regional Finance Leadership on reporting, governance and financial strategy. Ensure India finance reporting is aligned with global accounting standards, policies and reporting requirements. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1220 years of relevant experience . Strong experience in automotive components / auto parts manufacturing is highly preferred. Candidates from automotive OEMs, Tier-1 / Tier-2 automotive component manufacturers or engineering manufacturing companies would be preferred. Strong hands-on experience in plant finance and manufacturing finance . Proven expertise in costing, budgeting, MIS, working capital, CAPEX and financial controls . Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, product costing and operational KPIs. Experience in setting up or managing finance operations for a new plant / greenfield manufacturing project would be a strong advantage. Experience dealing with automotive OEM customers and their commercial requirements will be preferred. Strong exposure to ERP systems, preferably SAP. International / MNC experience and ability to work with global finance teams is desirable. Strong analytical, commercial and business partnering skills. Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 What We Are Looking For This is not a pure accounting role . We are looking for a finance leader who can combine plant finance expertise with commercial acumen and strategic business partnering .

Key Skills: Financial Planning and Analysis,Plant Controlling,Working Capital Management,Manufacturing Finance,Financial Planning,FP&A,Treasury Management,Inventory Valuation

title: Solution Architect
description:
Role overview EDMO is looking for a Solutions Architect to own how this will work for this customer across complex university implementations. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, engineering, and implementation, ensuring that what is promised to clients is technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with EDMOs core platform. You will lead technical discovery, design endtoend solutions(especially integrations and configuration), and guide implementations so that each deployment is repeatable rather than a oneoff custom project. 
 Key responsibilities Lead technical discovery with universities Run deepdive sessions with client IT and admissions teams to understand systems (CRM/SIS/LMS), telephony/chat stack (e.g., Genesys), SSO, security/compliance, and dataflow requirements. Translate business and admissionsprocess needs into clear technical requirements, constraints, and nonfunctional expectations (performance, privacy, retention, observability). Design endtoend solutions and integrations Own the solution blueprint for each customer: integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, MCPs / connectors), data contracts, mapping to CRM/SIS, and event flows into EDMO. Decide what is configuration vs. product gap vs. true custom work, clearly articulating tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Ensure solutions adhere to EDMOs architectural guardrails on security, multitenancy, scalability, and maintainability. Presales and scoping support Partner with Sales and Customer Success in latestage opportunities as the senior technical voice, especially where integrations and complex workflows are involved. Validate feasibility, effort, and risks before contracts/SOWs are signed, helping ensure EDMO does not commit to nonviable or nonscalable customizations. Contribute to RFP responses, solution summaries, and executivelevel technical presentations for key accounts. Implementation oversight and handoff Work closely with Implementation / Professional Services to turn the solution blueprint into a concrete plan: milestones, cutover strategy, environments, data migration, and UAT.Stay engaged through golive as an escalation point for scope changes, new technical risks, and critical design decisions that affect stability or timeline. Ensure a clean transition from project mode to steadystate Customer Success, with clear documentation and knowledge transfer. Architecture, standards, and product feedback Champion repeatability: push toward configuration, patterns, and reusable assets/templates instead of bespoke code on every project. Work with the CTO and Product to feed recurring client needs and integration patterns into the roadmap and reference architecture. Contribute to internal playbooks, reference diagrams, and best practices for integrations, security reviews, and enterprise onboarding. 
 What success looks like Enterprise university implementations go live with stable, observable integrations and minimal postgolive firefighting. Deals are scoped realistically, with fewer we sold something we cannot or should not build situations. Over time, more of what you design becomes standardized features and implementation patterns, reducing custom effort per customer. Required experience 10+ years in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, Integration Architect, Senior Engineer, or Solutions/PreSales Engineer in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment. Strong experience designing and implementing integrations between SaaS platforms and enterprise systems (CRM/SIS/ERP, telephony/contactcenter, identity providers, data platforms). Solid understanding of modern integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, eventdriven architecture, iPaaS/MCPstyle connectors, and data synchronization strategies. Handson familiarity with at least some of: Salesforce or other CRM, student information systems, contactcenter platforms (e.g., Genesys), and cloud platforms. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform. GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure is also acceptable. Working knowledge of serverless architectures and managed database services (e.g., Cloud SQL, Firestore, BigQuery, RDS, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB). Proven track record working directly with enterprise customers, leading technical workshops, and navigating between business and technical stakeholders. Ability to create clear solution artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration specs, sequencing diagrams, and SOW inputs understandable by both engineers and nontechnical leaders

description:
Location: Arena Space, Mumbai Experience: Approximately 24 years of relevant experience About the Role We are looking for an analytics professional who enjoys solving business problems, working with data and turning insights into action. The role works closely with Business Units, Commercial and Supply Chain teams to strengthen how data is used across the business. It combines business analytics, Power BI, reporting, data quality and automation, with broad exposure to commercial and operational decision-making. Expertise in every area from day one is not expected. A solid analytical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn are more important, along with the ability to bring structure to business questions and communicate findings clearly. What You’ll Do Business & Commercial Analytics Partner with Business Units to analyze sales performance, customer trends, product adoption, market development and growth opportunities. Turn business questions into structured analyses, insights and practical recommendations. Develop analyses that support business reviews and decision-making. Supply Chain Analytics Analyze inventory, demand, consumption, forecasting, availability and other supply chain metrics. Identify trends, exceptions and opportunities requiring action. Develop scalable reporting that improves access to information and reduces manual analysis. Power BI, Reporting & Automation Build, enhance and maintain Power BI dashboards for different business teams. Work across Power Query, data modelling, DAX, visualization and dashboard design. Support dashboard refreshes, validation, issue resolution and continuous improvement. Simplify and automate recurring reporting using Excel, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate and other appropriate tools. Explore AI and GenAI tools to improve analytical productivity and processes. Data Quality & Master Data Support the management and improvement of customer, product and commercial master data. Identify data-quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to address underlying causes. Contribute to clear data definitions, ownership and governance. Business Partnering & Storytelling Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and analytical requirements. Translate analysis into clear insights, implications and potential actions. Communicate findings effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including business leaders. What Will Help You Succeed Relevant experience can be gained in different ways. The following skills and experiences will help someone succeed in this role: Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, consulting, supply chain analytics or a related field. Experience with Power BI, Power Query, data modelling, visualization or DAX, or demonstrated ability and interest in developing these skills . Ability to bring structure to business questions where the answer may not be immediately clear. Attention to data quality and accuracy. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to different audiences. Curiosity about how the business works and an interest in continuous learning. Data Platform & Engineering  Design and Build the Microsoft Fabric data platform - Lakehouse/warehouse, layered structure, pipelines and Dataflows Gen 2 Integrate data from ERP, Sales, Distributor, Supply Chain and CRM sources into a single trusted model Set up workspace structure, deployment pipelines and version controls Monitor refreshes, performance and cost, fix failures at the source. Education An undergraduate or postgraduate degree, or equivalent relevant experience, providing a foundation for analytical problem-solving. Relevant areas may include Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Operations Research, Finance, or other quantitative disciplines . Candidates from a wide range of institutions, educational pathways and backgrounds are welcome. Relevant skills and experience will be considered alongside formal qualifications. As experience grows, the role will take increasing ownership of key dashboards, datasets and analytical initiatives, while building deeper capabilities across business partnering, Power BI, data management, automation and AI-enabled analytics. What Success Looks Like Success means becoming a trusted analytics partner to the business: improving the quality and accessibility of data, simplifying reporting and helping teams make better-informed decisions. title: Furniture Supervisor
description:
Role & Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day furniture production and factory operations at BDPs manufacturing facility in Karkhana Bagh, Faridabad . Plan production schedules based on project priorities, drawings, delivery dates and available manpower. Supervise manufacturing of bespoke loose furniture, fixed furniture, cabinetry, millwork, panelling and architectural joinery . Translate approved design and shop drawings into clear production instructions for carpenters, polish teams, upholstery teams, metal workers and other vendors. Coordinate closely with BDP’s designers, architects, project managers and site teams . Review drawings before production and flag technical or fabrication issues before work begins. Manage allocation and productivity of carpenters, craftsmen, helpers and specialist teams . Monitor projects through each production stage — cutting, carcass, joinery, assembly, finishing, upholstery, hardware installation, QC, packing and dispatch. Maintain strong quality control , particularly for joinery, dimensions, alignment, hardware, finishes and detailing. Ensure furniture is manufactured according to approved drawings, materials, samples and specifications . Prepare and maintain production trackers showing planned vs actual progress for every project/item. Coordinate procurement requirements for plywood, boards, veneers, laminates, hardware, timber, upholstery, finishes and consumables. Monitor material consumption, wastage and stock availability. Coordinate factory measurements and technical clarifications with project/site teams. Conduct final QC before furniture leaves the factory. Plan packing, loading, dispatch and installation coordination with project teams. Track rework, damages, snagging and rectification until closure. Maintain factory discipline, housekeeping, machinery upkeep and basic workplace safety. Proactively identify production bottlenecks and take ownership of resolving them. Preferred Candidate Profile: 
 4–8+ years of experience in furniture production, joinery, millwork or factory operations preferred. Strong practical understanding of bespoke furniture manufacturing and carpentry . Experience with both loose and fixed furniture is highly preferred. Should understand furniture drawings, dimensions, sections, joinery details and material specifications. Good knowledge of plywood, MDF/HDF, timber, veneer, laminate, hardware, polish, paint, upholstery and other furniture finishes . Familiarity with premium furniture hardware and fittings is an advantage. Should understand the difference between design intent and what is practically manufacturable . Strong ability to manage craftsmen, labour, vendors and multiple production jobs simultaneously. Comfortable maintaining production schedules, material requirements and QC checklists . Should be organised, hands-on and proactive rather than dependent on constant instructions. Experience in a bespoke furniture workshop, interior fit-out company, joinery factory or premium furniture manufacturer would be particularly relevant. Basic AutoCAD/drawing-reading ability is an advantage. Perks & Benefits: 
 Opportunity to work on custom-designed furniture rather than repetitive mass-production products . Exposure to furniture for residential, hospitality, F&B, retail and office projects . Work directly with BDP’s design, architecture and project teams — from initial drawings through prototyping, manufacturing and installation. Opportunity to develop stronger knowledge of materials, detailing, specialised finishes and furniture engineering . Significant ownership of the factory production process with scope to grow into a larger Factory Operations / Production Head role as the manufacturing division expands. Full-time, on-site position at Karkhana Bagh, Faridabad.
