description:
Hi, 

 We are hiring for Retail operation manager for our client is into Pharma business. 30 days leaves once in a year. Salary is tax free (in hand) plus shared accomodation,food ,visa,tickets etc. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION Retail Pharmacy Leader Company: Prince Farma
 Location: Angola
 Department: Retail Business
 Experience: Minimum 10-15 years
 Position Level: Senior Management / Leadership 1. Role Overview Prince Farma is looking for an experienced, commercially driven and entrepreneurial retail pharmacy leader to spearhead the development, establishment and expansion of its retail pharmacy chain in Angola. The position will have end-to-end responsibility for building and managing a profitable, scalable and customer-centric pharmacy retail business. The individual will lead the entire retail value chain, including business strategy, procurement and sourcing, category management, pricing, promotions, inventory management, store operations, new outlet expansion and customer experience. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of proven experience managing multi-outlet pharmacy retail operations, preferably with an established pharmacy chain. They should possess the ability to build a retail business from the ground up, establish robust systems and processes, drive commercial performance and lead teams across multiple locations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Retail Business Strategy & Commercial Management Develop and implement the overall retail pharmacy business strategy, aligned with the group's long-term vision. Drive revenue growth, profitability, market share and return on investment across the retail network. Develop annual budgets, business plans, sales forecasts and outlet-level targets. Establish business performance dashboards and monitor KPIs across all outlets. Identify opportunities to improve operating margins, productivity and cost efficiencies. Develop and execute strategies for scaling the retail network. B. Procurement, Sourcing & Vendor Management Lead centralised procurement and sourcing of pharmaceutical products, OTC medicines, dermocosmetics, baby care, wellness and other retail categories. Identify, evaluate and negotiate with local and international suppliers, distributors and manufacturers. Develop an optimal product assortment and category mix for different store formats. Negotiate commercial terms, purchase prices, credit periods, rebates, discounts and promotional support. Build strategic supplier partnerships to ensure product availability, competitive pricing and improved margins. Explore opportunities for private-label products and exclusive product partnerships. C. Pricing, Category Management & Promotions Develop the overall pricing strategy, ensuring competitiveness while maintaining targeted gross margins. Establish category-wise pricing structures, pricing guidelines and promotional calendars. Lead product assortment planning, range rationalisation and SKU productivity management. Develop seasonal campaigns, promotional offers, cross-selling and upselling initiatives. Drive loyalty programmes, customer retention and repeat-purchase initiatives. Monitor competitor pricing, product launches, promotions and market trends. D. Inventory & Supply Chain Management Establish robust inventory planning, replenishment and stock management systems. Ensure optimum stock levels across outlets, minimising stock-outs and overstocking. Drive inventory turns, working capital efficiency and stock availability. Establish systems for monitoring expiry dates, near-expiry products, slow-moving and non-moving inventory. Develop inter-store stock transfer and replenishment mechanisms. Ensure effective coordination between procurement, warehousing, distribution and individual outlets. Implement inventory controls and measures to minimise shrinkage, pilferage and stock losses. E. New Store Development & Expansion Identify and evaluate potential locations for new pharmacy outlets. Conduct feasibility studies, market assessments, competitor mapping and location profitability analysis. Lead negotiations for store leases and commercial agreements. Coordinate store design, layouts, fixtures, equipment, signage and merchandising. Drive the end-to-end process of setting up new outlets, including licensing, regulatory approvals, staffing, systems installation and launch. Develop standard operating procedures and a repeatable store-opening model. Ensure new stores achieve targeted sales and profitability within defined timelines. F. Retail Operations & Customer Experience Establish standard operating procedures and operational standards across all stores. Ensure consistent customer service, merchandising, store presentation and operational discipline. Develop a customer-centric retail culture focused on trust, convenience and professional healthcare advice. Implement customer engagement, loyalty and retention programmes. Monitor customer feedback and develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction. Ensure compliance with pharmaceutical regulations, storage conditions, prescription handling and dispensing requirements. G. Technology, Systems & Process Excellence Lead implementation and optimisation of retail ERP, POS, inventory management and reporting systems. Establish integrated processes for purchasing, billing, stock control, pricing and financial reporting. Use data analytics to drive assortment decisions, sales productivity and inventory efficiency. Introduce automation and standardised processes to improve operational effectiveness. Develop outlet-level dashboards and management reporting systems. H. People & Leadership Build and lead a high-performing retail management team. Recruit, develop and retain store managers, pharmacists and retail personnel. Establish performance management systems, training programmes and incentive structures. Develop succession plans and a strong internal talent pipeline. Drive accountability, ownership and a performance-oriented retail culture. 3. Desired Candidate Profile & Experience Minimum 10-15 years of experience in organised pharmacy retail, with at least 10 years in multi-store pharmacy chain operations. Demonstrated experience in managing and scaling a retail pharmacy network. Strong exposure to pharmaceutical procurement, sourcing, category management and vendor negotiations. Proven track record in pricing strategy, promotional planning and gross margin improvement. Extensive experience in inventory management, stock optimisation and working capital management. Hands-on experience in identifying locations, establishing new outlets and managing store launches. Strong understanding of pharmacy retail operations, regulatory compliance and customer engagement. Experience implementing retail ERP, POS and inventory management systems. Demonstrated ability to manage P&L responsibility and deliver profitable growth. Educational Qualifications Degree in Pharmacy, Business Administration, Retail Management or a related discipline. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business/Retail Management would be an advantage. A pharmacy qualification and appropriate professional registration would be an added advantage, particularly for overseeing pharmacy practice and regulatory compliance. 4. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities. Excellent commercial and financial acumen. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Analytical and data-driven decision-making. Entrepreneurial mindset and business-building capabilities. Strong leadership and people management skills. Customer-centric approach. Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The candidate will be evaluated against measurable business outcomes, including: Retail revenue growth and achievement of sales budgets. Gross margin and operating profitability. Same-store sales growth. New outlet openings against the expansion plan. Time taken for new stores to achieve break-even. Inventory turnover and working capital efficiency. Stock availability and reduction in stock-outs. Reduction in expiry-related losses and inventory shrinkage. Procurement savings and improvement in purchase margins. Customer satisfaction, loyalty programme penetration and repeat purchases. Employee productivity and store-level performance. Compliance with operational and regulatory standards. 6. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will establish Prince Farma's retail pharmacy business as a professionally managed, commercially successful and scalable pharmacy chain. They will be responsible for creating the systems, processes, team and operating model required to expand the network sustainably, deliver an excellent customer experience and establish a differentiated position in the Angolan pharmacy retail market. description:
PRODUCTION MANAGER HEAVY FABRICATION & MACHINING B Fouress Company in Hoskote, Bangalore, manufactures turbines and installs electro-mechanical equipment for small hydro power plants in India and overseas. For more information, visit www.bflhydro.com. Qualifications & Experience: Qualification: B.E Mechanical Engineering with 11 years to 14 years ROLE CONTEXT: - Production Manager will be responsible for ensuring the timely execution of production activities for turbines and turbine components in accordance with project schedules, approved budgets, and established quality standards. The role involves ensuring the availability and optimal utilization of machinery, equipment, manpower, and other production resources. The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements, monitoring the quality of incoming materials, and verifying that all outgoing products and shipments meet the specified technical and quality standards. DETAILED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Be responsible for planning the production of turbines and its components as per requirements Implement work instructions and process sheets for the production shopfloor Finalize the schedule plan for machine loading and turbine assembly on the shopfloor Conduct shopfloor production meetings and take necessary actions for fallouts Deploy systems for regular preventive maintenance; ensure timely breakdown maintenance to minimize downtime Control stores activity (receipts and shipments) and initiate actions in case of deviation Implement continuous improvement tools like 5S, Kaizen, Kanban etc on the shopfloor Ensure reduction in wastages/pilferage of material; responsible for safety of machines, equipment’s, power and other consumables Support implementation of of Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) regulations; and positive work culture and labour practices Implement a safety plan to ensure a safe and healthy work environment; enforce the use of PPEs (Personnel Protective Equipments) on the shopfloor Participate in safety audits and take preventive measures Review operational failures to analyze reasons and propose solutions to avoid recurrences Communicate the BFL Ideology to all workmen and provide/organise necessary training Improve production processes by deploying effective productiontools resulting in cost reduction and reduction in production cycle time Identify opportunities for outsourcing components manufacturing to improve efficiency and save time Prepare productivity trend charts and monitor the same Provide support to E&C team and also to sub-contract vendors Provide timely support for development of new processes / process improvements Ensure timely rework of site receipt assemblies Ensure timely completion of Refurbishments of site reciept assemblies. Ensure effective pollution and waste management as per defined norms Production Planning And Control Plan and monitor optimum utilization of the production capacity Monitor forecasting of raw material requirements Coordinate with various departments to develop the production plan and to ensure that production is carried out as per developed plans Instruct the production planning team in case of urgent orders and review progress of the same Monitor variance and take necessary corrective and / or preventive actions. Cost Efficiency Develop plant budgets encompassing manufacturing and manpower costs as per industry standards or as finalized with the COO Monitor cost of operations such as power, labour, consumables and maintenance at plant regularly to ensure expenses are within assigned budgets Monitor usage of raw materials, tools and equipment’s Ensure all expenses are restricted to predetermined budgets Quality Formulate strategies and systems for quality assurance and quality control to deliver efficient and quality products Review and monitor quality assurance and quality control at the plant to ensure they meet set standards Ensure development, deployment and sustenance of quality policies Ensure that turbines shipped out are on brand. Monitoring And Reviewing Manage, monitor and review the end-to-end manufacturing process which includes planning, production, maintenance and dispatch of manufactured goods to achieve production targets at optimum cost Monitor and review the supply chain strategy regularly Monitor and drive the 5S implementation plan Monitor and drive other quality initiatives Government Liaison Develop enduring relationships with government bodies and regulatory authorities Ensure compliance to all statutory norms Coordination Be a link between sales, commercial and operations for ease of inter-departmental functioning Safety Ensure safety and security of employees working in the plant Review and monitor safety and security measures at plant periodically Benefits: Free transport, subsidized canteen, all statutory benefits, including superannuation. Interested candidates may email their profiles within one week, including current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period, to shivaprasad@bflhydro.com

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
Job Summary 
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

 Role name and description 
 Senior, PC Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY's client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team! 

 The opportunity 
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY's global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals. Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities. Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients. 

 Your key responsibilities 
 On engagements, you will: Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities Within the actuarial practice you will: Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market Be able to build models from scratch Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage Familiarity with IFor Solvency II frameworks is preferred Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network. 

 Skills and attributes for success 
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team. 

 To qualify for the role, you must have 
 3+ years experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFtechnical provision, solvency II and risk management) Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus AI proficiency, automation mindset Good exam progress 

 Ideally, youll also have 
 Strong academic background with a bachelors degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience) AI Literacy Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage 

 What we look for 
 Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting

In this role, you will design, configure, implement, and support SAP Extended Warehouse Management solutions that enable warehouse, logistics, and production operations. You will partner with global business and technology teams to translate operational requirements into scalable solutions while contributing to the Consumer Products Group Digital Core program and broader SAP transformation initiatives. 
 Our Team You will be part of the Georgia-Pacific technology team within Koch Global Services India. Our international team designs, develops, and supports technology solutions for Koch businesses while helping expand Kochs technology and innovation capabilities in India. This role provides opportunities to work with global colleagues, contribute to strategic SAP initiatives, and develop solutions that support complex business operations.

title: Manager  Talent Acquisition
description:
Role Purpose To own and drive the complete manpower lifecycle at Koovers, from workforce planning and manpower requisition to talent acquisition, offer management and successful employee onboarding. The role will be responsible for ensuring timely availability of quality talent across business functions and locations, with a strong focus on bulk hiring, recruitment efficiency, process standardisation, technology adoption and automation. The incumbent will partner closely with business leaders to translate business growth plans into actionable manpower strategies and build a scalable, technology-driven recruitment and onboarding framework. 
 Key Responsibilities A. Manpower Planning & Workforce Management Partner with business heads and functional managers to understand current and future manpower requirements. Drive annual, quarterly and monthly manpower planning aligned with business growth and expansion plans. Develop and maintain manpower budgets, approved headcount and hiring plans. Monitor sanctioned strength, actual headcount, vacancies and manpower gaps across locations and functions. Establish a structured manpower requisition and approval process. Review manpower utilisation and hiring priorities with business stakeholders. Develop manpower dashboards and periodic reports to support business decisions. Ensure hiring is aligned with approved budgets and business priorities. B. Talent Acquisition & Bulk Hiring Own end-to-end talent acquisition across corporate, sales, warehouse, supply chain, operations and frontline roles. Drive high-volume and bulk recruitment to support business expansion and operational requirements. Develop effective sourcing strategies through job portals, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, walk-ins, social media and local talent networks. Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions. Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, define selection criteria and establish hiring timelines. Drive interview coordination, candidate evaluation, selection, compensation discussions and offer management. Ensure timely closure of open positions within agreed recruitment turnaround times. Improve offer acceptance and joining conversion ratios. Track recruitment productivity, sourcing effectiveness, cost per hire and quality of hire. Build and maintain recruitment MIS, dashboards and hiring performance reports. Establish recruitment processes and standard operating procedures across locations. C. Offer Management & Onboarding Own the candidate journey from offer acceptance to successful joining. Drive structured pre-joining engagement to minimise candidate dropouts and offer declines. Ensure timely release of offer letters and completion of joining formalities. Coordinate with business teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure readiness for new employee onboarding. Establish standardised onboarding checklists, documentation and induction processes. Ensure timely employee data creation and onboarding updates in HRMS. Drive a consistent and seamless joining experience across locations. Track offer-to-joining ratios, onboarding completion and early-stage joining attrition. D. Systems, Automation & Process Excellence Drive adoption and effective utilisation of ATS and HRMS platforms. Identify opportunities to automate manpower requisitions, approval workflows and recruitment processes. Digitise candidate tracking, interview scheduling, offer management and onboarding documentation. Develop centralised dashboards for manpower planning, recruitment progress and onboarding metrics. Improve recruitment process visibility through system-driven tracking and reporting. Standardise workflows to reduce manual intervention, duplication and turnaround time. Continuously identify and implement technology-led process improvements. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Education Graduate degree required; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. Experience 812 years of talent acquisition experience, including experience managing multi-location or frontline hiring. At least 12 years of team leadership experience preferred. Must-have skills and competencies End-to-end recruitment. High-volume and lateral hiring. Sourcing strategy and candidate assessment. Recruitment metrics and ATS usage. Hiring manager relationship management. Offer negotiation and closure. Recruitment planning and prioritization. Team coordination and coaching. Good-to-have skills Employer branding. Campus hiring. Recruitment automation. Workforce planning. Experience with recruitment agencies and local sourcing partners. Industry and functional exposure Automotive, distribution, retail, logistics, e-commerce, warehousing or other multi-location businesses.

title: Store Manager
description:
Job Description - Store Manager 
 Company: Innovative Lighting Designs Limited (ILDL)
 Location: Okhla Phase 1, New Delhi
 Department: Stores & Logistics 
 Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent, on-site

 Job Summary 
ILDL is seeking an experienced Store Manager to run its store operations end to end. The incumbent will make sure that products reach project sites accurately, on time, undamaged and that stock, order, dispatch and sample records are accurate and current at all times. The role involves leading the store team and working daily with the Accounts, Technical, CRM, Procurement and Assembly teams. 
 Role & Responsibilities 
 Store operations and inventory 
 Manage end-to-end store operations, including material receipt, verification against purchase orders, storage, issue of material and order processing. Maintain accurate stock and order records, with inward and outward entries posted on the same working day and order status updated daily. Plan and conduct regular physical stock verification, investigate variances and close them within the agreed time. Ensure Material Receipt Notes (MRN) and daily material receipt and outward (DMR / DMO) records are prepared accurately, with shortages and damages recorded at the time of receipt. 
 Dispatch and logistics 
 Plan and coordinate packing, dispatch and delivery of confirmed orders, including transport mode and freight arrangements. Maintain the dispatch tracker and keep it matched with actual dispatches; issue delivery challans for temporary dispatches and samples. Ensure correct packing as per order specifications and maintain packaging standards to minimise damage, shortages and wrong shipments. Keep the CRM team updated on dispatch status, with the required documents, on the day of dispatch. 
 Samples and mock-ups 
 Supervise availability, tracking and dispatch of samples and mock-up material, including decorative and automation samples, so that Technical and CRM teams receive them on time. 
 Procurement support 
 Prepare import and local indents as required and coordinate with the Procurement team on timelines. 
 Coordination and queries 
 Coordinate daily with the Accounts, Technical, CRM, Procurement and Assembly teams. Respond to and resolve stock-related, ongoing-project and completed-project queries within the agreed turnaround. 
 Team and safety 
 Lead, train and supervise the store team, including store assistants, helpers and local delivery staff; allocate duties and review performance against defined KRAs. Ensure safe handling, storage, housekeeping and safety practices in the store and during loading and unloading. Prepare weekly and monthly reports on stock accuracy, on-time dispatch, damage and shortages, pending orders and open queries. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 Minimum 7 years of experience in store, warehouse, inventory or logistics management, including experience of leading a team. Experience in lighting, electrical, electronics, building materials or other project-based products is preferred; experience of handling import consignments and fragile or high-value items is an advantage. Hands-on knowledge of inventory control, stock verification, material receipt and issue, and dispatch documentation such as delivery challans, invoices and e-way bills. Working knowledge of ERP or inventory software and MS Excel for records and reports. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and on-time delivery. Good written and verbal communication, and the ability to coordinate with several departments. Ability to supervise, train and motivate a team of store staff. Willingness to work on-site at the store. 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management or Commerce is preferred.

Key Skills: Store Operation,Store operations,Store keeping,Store supervision,Management,Store management,Inventory,Planning

title: Administration Executive
description:
About the Role: We are seeking a Proactive Office Administrator to support the smooth functioning of our corporate operations. This role involves overseeing daily office tasks, vendor coordination, procurement, event setup, and cross-departmental support. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly disciplined, and demonstrates a strong sense of ownership and integrity. As an integral part of the administration team, you will ensure that business operations are well-organized and run efficiently in a dynamic work environment. 
 Key Responsibilities: Administrative Operations: Provide end-to-end support in office administration including documentation, procurement, and daily operational tasks. Event & Facility Management: Assist in planning, organizing, and managing events and facility requirements, including logistics and vendor coordination. Procurement & Purchase Oversight: Manage procurement activities, vendor interactions, and timely purchasing of office and project-related supplies. Time Discipline & Professional Conduct: Uphold punctuality, honesty, and a "lead by example" attitude in all work assignments. Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate and liaise with internal departments such as HR, IT, Finance, and external vendors for operational needs. MIS & Reporting: Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports, including MIS dashboards for department tracking and performance metrics. Vendor & Asset Management: Oversee housekeeping, security, store, and asset management to ensure upkeep and accountability. ERP & Office Tools: Operate office management systems, ERP platforms, and MS Office tools for seamless workflow execution. Communication & Coordination: Act as the point of contact for internal teams and external vendors, maintaining clear and professional communication. Team Assistance & Leadership Support: Support administration team members and provide backup coverage and coordination in absence of peers or leads. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile: Experience: 2 to 7 years in an office administration, operations, or executive assistant role within a corporate setting. Educational Qualification: Bachelors degree in Office Administration, Business Management, or a related field. Secretarial qualifications are a plus. Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with all stakeholders. Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and maintain high levels of accuracy and follow-through. Leadership & Initiative: Self-motivated with a proactive mindset and capable of taking ownership of tasks independently. Technology Proficiency: Proficient in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiar with ERP or office management software. Professional Conduct: Demonstrates high integrity, punctuality, and the ability to lead by example. Multitasking & Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with flexibility in work hours and responsibilities. Knowledge of Admin Functions: Familiar with housekeeping, security, asset tracking, vendor management, and store handling. Team Orientation: Willing to assist across functions and contribute to team success with a collaborative attitude.

description:
Role: Cloud Engineer Experience: 3 - 6 Years Notice Period: Immediate - 15 days Location: Chennai, Bangalore & Pune (Hybrid)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with 3 - 6 years of experience in Azure or AWS cloud administration and infrastructure operations. The candidate will be responsible for managing cloud incidents, implementing changes, provisioning infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), monitoring cloud environments, and ensuring service delivery within defined SLAs. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on cloud administration experience, troubleshooting capabilities, and knowledge of automation and ITIL processes. 
 Key Responsibilities Handle and resolve L1-escalated cloud infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs. Manage standard and normal changes following approved change management procedures. Provision, configure, and manage cloud resources using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Perform backup, restoration, patch validation, and disaster recovery activities. Configure and support Azure/AWS PaaS services, including databases, storage, application services, and serverless components. Monitor cloud infrastructure, configure alerts, and optimize dashboards. Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, access, and compute-related issues. Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge articles. Identify opportunities for automation and continuous operational improvement. Coordinate with senior engineers, L1 teams, and customer support teams for incident resolution and change implementation. 
 Required Technical Skills Hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure or AWS cloud administration. Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Knowledge of cloud networking, virtual machines, storage, backup, and disaster recovery. Experience with cloud monitoring and observability tools. Understanding of PaaS services, databases, application services, and serverless computing. Basic scripting knowledge in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Familiarity with AKS/EKS and container technologies. Understanding of cloud security, identity and access management (IAM), and governance. Knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL practices. 
 Mandatory Certifications AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator) OR AWS SysOps Administrator Associate (SOA-C03) / AWS Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03). HashiCorp Terraform Associate. ITIL 4 Foundation. Note: Candidates who do not hold the required primary cloud associate-level certification must be willing to complete it within 6 months of joining. 
 Experience & Qualifications 3 - 6 years of overall IT infrastructure experience. 3 - 6 years of hands-on cloud experience in Azure or AWS. Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Willingness to work in rotational/rostered shifts and participate in on-call support. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Strong hands-on experience in either Azure or AWS, with basic working knowledge of the other cloud platform. Experience in L2 cloud operations and incident management. Good understanding of SLA management, change management, and root cause analysis. Ability to follow operational procedures and maintain accurate technical documentation. Proactive approach towards automation and process improvement.

title: Business Analyst / Operations Analyst
description:
About Cascade 
Cascade California Realty is a full-service boutique residential brokerage serving the San Francisco Bay Area since 2013. We take pride in delivering personalized guidance tailored to each client. With nearly $600M+ in closed transactions, we take pride in guiding our clients through every step of your real estate journey in Silicon Valley. 
 Job Summary 
As part of our operations team currently based in Kerala, the business analyst will work on various functional areas including researching residential real estate properties in California, assist with marketing / digital marketing initiatives, communicating with our clients, research on analytics and help run the business operations of the company. This position will be an integral part of the business development, operations and customer experience for the company. 
 The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator, a quick learner, have excellent analytical skills, and reasonably well-versed with computers. A good academic background and/or professional track record would be highly desirable. 
 Location & Work Hours 
The work hours are in PACIFIC TIME ZONE (PST), which works out to be NIGHT SHIFT in India, Monday through Friday, with rotational on-call work. Those who are based in Kerala will be given preference, since the rest of the team is based in Kerala. The position will be 100% remote . You may be required to travel 2-4 times every year for in-person team meetings. 


 Required Qualifications and Experience ( Please read this before applying ) Personal integrity and total honesty in everything you do is a non-negotiable requirement. ( Please check your resume for total accuracy and clarity before applying.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English needed. Bachelors degree is required, preferably in Science, Business, Management, Engineering, Finance or Mathematics. A recent MBA or a related masters degree will be a huge plus. While freshers may be considered, those with work experience in any field may be given preference. Those who are based in Kerala will be given preference since the rest of the team is located in Kerala. Please note that this is not a clerical job, excellent analytical skills and dedication to the job is needed. 
 Key Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is a must. Familiarity with MacOS and/or Windows, Google Docs, MS Word and Excel Analytical and problem solving skills Ability to adapt and learn fast, and willingness to experiment and research could make you successful in this position. Web Development / SEO / Digital Marketing experience will be a plus, but not required. 
 Responsibilities and Duties As an operations / business analyst, ensure the transactions are compliant with the laws and regulations in California and Oklahoma, and documentation per company policies is strictly adhered to. Project manage real estate transactions, construction projects and marketing initiatives working with different stakeholders. Prepare and execute legal contracts using the tools provided. Working during business hours in California (Pacific Standard Time) is expected Monday through Friday. Participation in the on-call rotation schedule is expected. 
 Benefits For the right candidate, we offer very competitive salaries, training, mentorship, formal education/training as needed, flexibility to work 100% remotely from your home, generous expense reimbursements, paid health insurance and paid holidays and time off days. You will also have the potential for earning large bonuses in addition to the base salary (dependent on company revenue growth / personal performance), annual pay raises that are generally way higher than in the industry, and opportunities to learn the skills of entrepreneurship and business, working with a small super talented team with a startup culture and an amazing work ethic. 
 Other benefits include internet reimbursement, reimbursement of movie tickets for self and friends, annual dinner with family at a top restaurant, vacation travel, fun team trips, team get togethers, home office furnishing and accessories etc. 
 More than any of the above, you will get to work with a fine team of professionals and get experience with all aspects of running a company, rather than doing a few tasks repetitively everyday.

title: Video Editing And Graphic Designer
description:
JobShop is a recruitment company specialising in BPO and customer support hiring. We are looking for a creative and energetic Video Editor & Content Creator who can help us build our brand presence across social media platforms through engaging videos, reels, and digital content. 
 As a Video Editor, you will work across events, brands, social media, podcasts, interviews, corporate content and digital campaigns. 
 We are looking for someone who doesnt just know how to edit but understands storytelling, pacing, music, emotion and what makes people stop scrolling. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and social media videos Edit event aftermovies, highlights and recap videos Edit interviews, podcasts and corporate videos Create engaging short-form content from long-form footage Add music, sound effects, captions, transitions and motion graphics Perform basic colour correction and audio enhancement Create videos according to brand guidelines Work with the creative and events teams to understand the objective of each video Select the best footage and create a strong narrative Handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines Make revisions based on client and internal feedback Organise and manage video footage and project files efficiently 
 Tools Required 
 Must have: 
 * Adobe Premiere Pro * Adobe After Effects * CapCut 
 Good to have: 
 * Adobe Photoshop * Adobe Audition * DaVinci Resolve * Canva * Frame.io 
 AI tools / emerging technology added advantage: 
 * Runway * Adobe Firefly * Descript * ElevenLabs * OpusClip 
 Skills We Are Looking For 
 * Strong storytelling ability * Excellent sense of timing and pacing * Understanding of social media trends * Good eye for visuals and composition * Strong music sense * Attention to detail * Ability to create strong hooks in the first few seconds * Understanding of typography and motion graphics * Ability to work under tight deadlines * Ability to take feedback positively and make quick changes * Good communication and teamwork * Ability to work independently and take ownership 
 The Most Important Skill 
 Don’t just be an editor. Be a storyteller. 
 We want someone who can look at 2 hours of footage and understand: 
 What is the story? What should people see? What should they feel? And why should they keep watching? 
 Experience 
 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred. 
 Freshers with an exceptional portfolio and strong editing skills may also apply. 
 Experience in events, advertising, branded content, digital media or social media will be an advantage. 
 What We Expect 
 * Creativity * Speed * Ownership * Curiosity * Attention to detail * Willingness to experiment * Ability to handle multiple deadlines 
 Practical Test 
 Shortlisted candidates will be given raw footage and asked to create a 30-second social media Reel. 
 We will evaluate: 
 * Storytelling * Hook * Editing * Music * Pacing * Visual creativity * Captions * Overall impact 
 Location :Bengaluru 
 Employment / Full-time 
 Apply 
 Please share your CV + portfolio/showreel + links to 3 of your best social media videos.

description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer and Video Editor Location: Chennai Job Type: Full-Time Job Summary: We are looking for a skilled and creative Graphic Designer and Video Editor to join our dynamic team at Digital Mantraaz, a leading digital marketing agency. The ideal candidate will have a passion for design and visual storytelling, with the ability to create compelling graphics and engaging video content that drives our clients' digital marketing campaigns. The role involves working closely with the marketing, social media, and content teams to produce high-quality visual content that resonates with target audiences and enhances brand presence across digital platforms. Key Responsibilities: Graphic Design: Design eye-catching and innovative graphics for digital marketing campaigns, including social media posts, email templates, banner ads, and website visuals. Create graphics for various digital platforms, ensuring consistency with each clients brand identity. Collaborate with marketing strategists to understand campaign goals and translate them into visually compelling assets. Develop branded visuals for landing pages, PPC ads, and social media profiles. Stay current with the latest design trends and tools to create fresh, appealing content for digital audiences. Video Editing: Produce and edit video content for social media, advertisements, YouTube, and other digital channels, ensuring each piece is optimized for the intended platform. Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to brainstorm, storyboard, and develop video content that drives engagement and conversions. Edit promotional, instructional, and short-form video content, adding necessary effects, animations, and transitions. Incorporate motion graphics, typography, and visual effects to enhance video projects. Optimize video content for different social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, etc.), understanding the format and content strategies for each. Campaign Asset Development: Adapt and create new digital assets for various advertising platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.). Design thumbnails, end screens, and overlays for video campaigns to enhance engagement and click-through rates. Work with performance marketing teams to iterate on design concepts that drive better results based on data-driven feedback. Branding and Consistency: Ensure all visual content aligns with each client's brand guidelines and overall marketing strategy. Maintain consistency in tone, style, and messaging across all graphic and video content. Participate in brainstorming sessions to offer creative solutions and concepts for marketing campaigns. Requirements: Proven experience as a Graphic Designer and Video Editor in a digital marketing environment, with a portfolio showcasing successful projects. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro) or equivalent tools for graphic design and video editing. Solid understanding of visual design principles, typography, color theory, and layout for both static and motion content. Experience creating digital assets for social media platforms and digital ads, with knowledge of best practices for each platform. Strong understanding of video production and editing techniques, including animation and motion graphics. Ability to work under tight deadlines, manage multiple projects, and pivot quickly based on client or campaign needs. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with clients and internal teams. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Multimedia Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field. Experience working in a digital marketing agency or with brands in the digital marketing space. Knowledge of SEO and content marketing strategies is a plus. Understanding of marketing performance metrics and data-driven design. What We Offer: Competitive salary based on experience. Opportunity to work with a diverse range of brands and industries. A collaborative, creative work environment with room for professional growth.
